rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 野田内閣総辞職, dated 26 December 2012, says that the Noda cabinet resigned en masse that day: at that day's cabinet meeting the ministers' resignations were gathered and the resignation en masse decided, after which the Prime Minister's statement on the resignation was issued.

locator.section: 総理の一日 > 平成24年 > 平成24年12月26日 野田内閣総辞職

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same account says that 野田総理 left the Prime Minister's Office, seen off by the staff, and its photograph caption reads 職員から花束を受ける野田総理.
